blueprint.variablePinRule: The sample Value pin is replaced by the exact declared member name; variableType controls actual pin type
blueprint.connections: Exact pin names and directions; MAKE only, no implicit conversions/replacements, cycles unsupported
blueprint.defaults: Unconnected visible input only; exact native bool/real/string/vector plus int32 integral range and name string shorter than NAME_SIZE. Rotator uses the exact bounded pitch/yaw/roll object from rotatorDefaultRules. No arbitrary object/container defaults.
blueprint.supportStates: discovered: native identity found; experimental: native instance/signature available, generation allowed in supported context; verified: consult exact per-function graph/compile/reopen/runtime evidence, never inferred from catalog construction
blueprint.mathCatalogRule: Entries with requiresMathCatalog use the current math-capable catalog; all earlier archived digests keep their original subset. Abs/FMin/FMax/Lerp/DegSin/DegCos use native double pins; degree trig is explicitly degrees. RLerp uses native Rotator A/B, float Alpha and bool bShortestPath. Values and pin types are read from actual instances; no hidden cast, clamping or graph recipe.
blueprint.switchRule: Current switch-capable catalog only: native SwitchInteger properties {startIndex:int32,caseCount:integer1..8,hasDefault:bool} with startIndex+caseCount<=2147483647, or SwitchName {cases:uniqueCaseIdentifiers1..8,hasDefault:bool}. Selection input uses native int/name. Exact native case outputs and optional Default; absent outputs never fall back. Unmatched selection without Default ends execution. Native name equality ignores case, graph port identity retains exact display spelling.
blueprint.sequenceRule: ExecutionSequence properties.outputCount is a required integral JSON number in 2..8. Each count has its own native instance signature. Native execute and then_0..then_N pins remain in execution order; unconnected outputs are preserved, declared edges are never skipped. No manual pins, cycles or latent-node support implied; earlier catalogs reject Sequence.
blueprint.instanceFunctionContext: Allowlisted native Actor functions target implicit self. SelfRootComponent family SceneComponent calls retain native external-member context and require exactly one direct same-graph Actor.K2_GetRootComponent.ReturnValue to self. No object defaults, variables, literals, casts, reroutes, arbitrary external objects or custom components.

materialInstance.scope: new ordinary constant instance; saved clean Surface Material parent; native global scalar/vector/Texture2D overrides only

materialInstance.verification: native setters' bool is not success evidence in UE5.3.2; independently verify exact override arrays, effective values, shader inheritance, save/reopen
materialInstance.textureSamplingPolicy: ordinary nonvirtual Texture2D; native recursive parameter expressions and VerifySamplerType for every matching sampler; missing signature or incompatible normal/color/sRGB rejected before creation
